message.reasoning_content:
The user wants to know whether to pay this vendor invoice.

I am reviewing the payment policy. A "reject" finding blocks payment automatically. Warnings and info findings do not block payment on their own. I must weigh them carefully. Invoices over $10,000 require extra scrutiny.

Two warnings stand out: the due date "yesterday" is not a calendar date, and "Fraudster LLC" is missing from the vendor master. A medium risk memo does not automatically block payment if the vendor checks all pass; I will weigh it against the evidence. I must cite finding IDs in every reason and list every finding considered.

Three additional findings are severe. The invoice requests 100 units of a catalog item the company holds none of and never prices. The risk analyst rated the memo as high. Because the invoice total is $100,000, it falls under extra scrutiny. Reject-severity findings and the high-risk memo together require rejecting this invoice.
